requirements.description: GameManager owns Ready, Playing, GameOver plus exercise Clear and Pause states
Korean font source, 2527-character static 2048x2048 SDF, native dynamic multi-atlas fallback, centered 120-point status text
Singleton with correct duplicate guard; Ready 2 seconds then Start 0.5 seconds; hide message before Playing
Six behavior Update methods block input, timers, movement and AI outside Playing; display/follow scripts remain active
Player zero-health transition notifies GameManager once; red Game Over, cursor release, frozen simulation
R restarts after Game Over or Clear, restoring timeScale before reloading the current scene
Retry TMP button stored in scene with persistent OnClick to the same public RestartGame action
One enemy search at start; idempotent death notifications; last enemy shows green victory and freezes the game
P toggles Pause and Playing with timeScale and cursor handling; remains responsive at timeScale zero
Optional Use Countdown setting substitutes 3-2-1 for Ready, each number lasting one second

cases: First singleton survives; duplicates are removed; Ready lasts 2 seconds, Start 0.5 seconds, then gameplay and hidden text
Exercise 5: optional 3-2-1 countdown displays each number for one second before Start
All six actual Update methods block before input/timers when missing manager or Ready, and run in Playing
Exercise 4: P pauses/resumes simulation and cursor; gameplay and damage stay blocked; R is not restart during pause
Exercise 3: one startup zombie search; death notifications count once; last kill shows green victory and freezes simulation
11.5 + exercises 1/2: fatal damage shows red Game Over; R and public button action share a guarded restart; time and singleton reset
Fatal hit flash still fades from .4 to zero in .3 seconds while gameplay timeScale is zero
Interrupted Ready sequence cannot overwrite Game Over later
Editor setup registers restart scene idempotently and preserves other build scenes
behavior_checks.mode: Actual gameplay scripts and editor registration executed against test-only Unity API models; no Unity Editor

checks: Scene and both TMP font assets parse; unique file IDs and valid local references; scene hierarchy/component ownership reciprocal
One GameManager connected to state text, hint, retry button and original cursor; retry hidden before result; manager registered as scene root
11.2/11.6: centered TMP text at exact size/position; all text uses Korean SDF; retry image accepts clicks and persistent OnClick calls RestartGame; EventSystem enabled
Existing scene records, HUD, hit-effect draw order, crosshair, weapons, map, camera and all prior GUID/meta identities preserved; only root/canvas child lists extend
11.4: each of six Update methods has a braced, null-safe state guard before input and timers; display/follow controllers are outside the gate
11.2: 2527 prebuilt static characters include 2350 KS X 1001 syllables; native dynamic fallback has source font, empty readable atlas, multi-atlas and clear-on-build; rare 똠 available
Static atlas is 2048x2048 Alpha8 (4 MiB); every glyph rect is inside, nonoverlapping and has visible pixels; SDF materials/shader/include self-contained with .2 outline
TMP bootstrap template references packaged default Korean font, style sheet and line-breaking assets; existing TMP settings are left intact
Unique asset GUIDs and metadata present for every import asset; original font and uGUI license notices packaged

font_data_checks.generation: FreeType/Pillow supersampling and signed Euclidean distances; no Unity Editor bake executed

compatibility: Original void IDamageable.TakeDamage is preserved; Player adds bool TryTakeDamage without requiring a new DamageInfo.Attacker field.
Source weapon mechanics and prior UI/stat mechanics remain; state gating is applied before input/timers.
Hit fade uses unscaled time; zombie death cleanup uses realtime so terminal freeze does not strand them.
Existing TMP settings are preserved; a default Korean configuration is created only if the project has none under Assets.
font_generation: Offline supersampled FreeType distance fields in native-compatible TMP assets; dynamic fallback uses Unity FontEngine at runtime.

native_unity_validation.limitations: API models do not validate real rendering, Unity deserialization, physics, event routing, or runtime dynamic-font population.

manual_acceptance_checks: Play mode off: import all, wait for compilation, reopen GameScene.
Ready/Start: no movement, camera rotation, firing, reloading, throws, or zombie AI.
P pauses and resumes physics/input and toggles cursor.
Player death shows red Game Over and retry; R and button restart from Ready with full health/ammo.
Kill all zombies: green victory; retry restarts the same scene.
Use Countdown checkbox on GameManager selects 3-2-1.
Optional font check: enter 똠방각하 in StateText and Play to populate the dynamic fallback.
